items.sentence: In [MASK], S1 stated in front of coworkers that because the Agency canceled her surgery, she should go to another hospital for services, thereby disclosing her confidential medical information in violation of the Rehabilitation Act. 3 3.
During [MASK], Complainant was required to work with coworkers who had improperly accessed her confidential medical records without authorization. 4.
During [MASK], management failed to resolve Complainant’s sick leave issues in a timely manner. 5.
On [MASK], Complainant’s coworker referred to her as “a 50-year-old mental patient.” 6.
On [MASK], S1 told Complainant’s coworker, who was allegedly bullying and harassing Complainant, not to worry and that she “had her back.” 7.
